sections.voiceover: Those allegations cover 6 women and a decade spanning from 1999 to 2009.

Court documents reveal 3 counts of rape and 3 counts of sexual assault. Alongside those charges, 1 count of indecent assault was filed against him. Prosecutors presented the case at Southwark Crown Court.
Southwark Crown Court heard prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC deliver opening arguments.
